description: Backend that lets Commandeer Cloud reach this computer's coding agents
notes: The release files are private: run 'scoop config gh_token <token>' with a GitHub token that can read Nimblesite/acp_client before installing or updating.

Configure this computer once, then it starts serving: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "$dir\package\install.ps1" -Prefix "$dir" -State "$persist_dir" -Central https://<central>/ -SupabaseUrl https://<project>.supabase.co -SupabaseKey <publishable key>
Enroll this computer once, after the configure step wrote host.json: conversation-host login "$persist_dir\broker\host.json" "$persist_dir\broker\device.json"
Add --github before the two files only when the central server has GitHub sign-in configured.
